profile.name: Mateusz Ciszek
profile.bio: I build games and the systems behind them. My work spans 2D and 3D gameplay, reusable Unity tools, and Android applications. I care about responsive interactions, maintainable code, and giving a good idea room to grow.

projects.title: 100 in 1 Game Collection
projects.summary: A selection of mini-games I designed and programmed in Unity and C# for 100 in 1 Game Collection on Nintendo Switch and Steam.
projects.imageAlt: 100 in 1 Game Collection cover featuring a collage of its arcade mini-games
overview: These are the mini-games I designed and programmed for the collection, along with selected mechanics and technical contributions.

miniGames.title: Rabbit Hopper
miniGames.description: A Frogger-inspired crossing game with traffic that reacts to the player: school buses slow down nearby, while sports cars accelerate. Fire hydrants launch the player forward, creating shortcuts through the level.

miniGames.title: Space Doggo
miniGames.description: A Pang-inspired arcade game in which a space-faring dog battles waves of bouncing aliens. Blaster upgrades and power-ups help the player clear each level.

miniGames.title: Sweets Crusher
miniGames.description: Control food claws along the X-axis to grab descending sweets and reposition them into vertical match-three combinations. Clear the board and use power-ups to prevent it from overflowing.

miniGames.title: Reversi
miniGames.description: Classic Reversi with an AI opponent designed to offer a competitive but approachable challenge.
technicalNotes: AI balancing: the main challenge was making the opponent strategically capable without making it frustratingly difficult to beat.

miniGames.title: Cosmic Painter
miniGames.description: A Qix-inspired game where a painter claims sections of a canvas with a magical brush. Roaming ink containers undo progress, while power-ups provide temporary boosts and protection.

miniGames.title: Dinosaurs Mania
miniGames.description: An Elasto Mania-inspired motorcycle game set in a prehistoric world. Precise bike control and physics-based movement let players climb, flip, and ride across challenging terrain.

miniGames.title: CatPotionCraft
miniGames.description: A potion-themed puzzle game starring a magical cat. Aim potions and match colorful ingredients to clear the board while balancing quick reactions with careful planning.

miniGames.title: Bombastic Witch
miniGames.description: A Bomberman-inspired game where a witch uses explosive spells to fight enchanted crows. Navigate grid-based arenas, destroy obstacles, and set traps.
technicalNotes: Analog-stick grid movement: interpolated movement and trajectory adjustments near obstacles guide the player around corners and reduce abrupt stops.
Versus-mode features: Ring of Fire and teleport mechanics.

miniGames.title: Dungeon Dragons
miniGames.description: A Battle City-inspired game where a dragon defends its land against invading Vikings. Breathe fire, destroy obstacles, and outmaneuver enemies in maze-like arenas.

projects.title: A Game About Clicking A Rock
projects.summary: One rock. A growing mining operation. A 3D incremental game about turning a simple click into an automated empire.
projects.imageAlt: A Game About Clicking A Rock official game artwork
overview: A personal Unity project built around mining, upgrades, and automated workers. Available to explore on itch.io, with a Steam store page for the upcoming PC release.
Built data-driven ore balancing and progression using ScriptableObjects, event-driven resource updates, English/Polish localization, and a guided first-run tutorial.
Implemented autosave, JSON save/load, exportable encoded save codes, and finite-state-machine worker AI with node-based movement.

screenshots.alt: Official gameplay screenshot from A Game About Clicking A Rock on Steam

projects.title: MaCster Unity Framework
projects.summary: A modular foundation for gameplay, from inventories and interactions to node-based dialogue tools.
overview: A private C#/Unity library of reusable gameplay systems and editor tools.
Includes saving, object pooling, inventory management, shop/cart logic, 3D interaction, player movement, and dialogue graphs.
Uses ScriptableObject data, interface-based contracts, and event-driven UI flows. The xNode dialogue tooling supports conditional branches, player responses, action nodes, and runtime playback.

projects.title: Mobile E-Commerce App
projects.summary: An Android shopping application covering products, purchases, and order tracking.
overview: Built a mobile e-commerce application in Kotlin with Android Studio and Google Firebase.
Implemented product and order management, user registration, purchasing, and order tracking/history. Designed and implemented the Firebase database.

projects.title: Mobile Game · Engineering Thesis
projects.summary: A working Android game prototype exploring engagement and player retention through academic research.
overview: Bachelor’s thesis: Using Social Engineering Methods in a Mobile Game.
Developed the game concept, MVP design, and a working Android prototype with a responsive UI that adapts to different screen resolutions.
Researched scientific literature and mobile games to analyze engagement, retention, and monetization techniques.

projects.title: Learning to Find a Path
projects.summary: A reinforcement learning experiment that trains an agent to navigate toward a moving target.
overview: A Unity/C# proof of concept using reinforcement learning to train an AI agent to navigate toward a dynamically changing target.
